# apple_scm_repositories (Data Source)

Lists repositories connected to Xcode Cloud. Use the repository's ID as `repository_id` on `apple_ci_workflow`. The SCM connection must already be set up in Xcode or App Store Connect.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_scm_repositories" "all" {}

output "repositories" {
  value = data.apple_scm_repositories.all.repositories
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) The most records to return, between 1 and 200, after filtering and sorting.
- `name_pattern` (String) Return only records whose `repository_name` matches this regular expression, matched as a substring unless anchored.
- `sort_by` (String) The attribute to sort by: `last_accessed_date`, `owner_name`, `repository_name`. Unset keeps Apple's order.
- `sort_order` (String) `asc` (the default) or `desc`. Has no effect without `sort_by`.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) How many records are returned, after filtering and the limit.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The records that match, in the order asked for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `total_count` (Number) How many records Apple returned, before filtering.

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `http_clone_url` (String) The repository's HTTPS clone URL.
- `id` (String) Apple's ID for the record, which `apple_ci_workflow` takes as a relationship.
- `last_accessed_date` (String) When Xcode Cloud last read the repository, in ISO 8601.
- `owner_name` (String) The account or organisation that owns the repository.
- `repository_name` (String) The repository's name at the source control provider, without the owner.
- `ssh_clone_url` (String) The repository's SSH clone URL.
